collection.title: Fiat Croma 1985 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Fiat Croma 1985 to 1996 model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Croma, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
